batch: Defraggler displayed version, source route and end-of-life reconciliation

indexedProductDownloadPage.observation: The official-domain search result exposes release notes for Defraggler v2.22.995 dated 21 May 2018.
indexedProductDownloadPage.directOpenResult: Redirects to https://www.ccleaner.com/defraggler and returns a JavaScript-only page; no artifact or digest was exposed.

publisherEndOfLifeAnnouncement.statement: The publisher says the last build shipped in August 2020, its product/download/support pages were removed, and it will no longer distribute, sell or support Defraggler.

versionAndArtifactAssessment.lastBuildPerPublisherEolNotice: Shipped in August 2020; exact version/artifact identity not given in the announcement.
versionAndArtifactAssessment.reconciliation: The 2018 version/date in indexed release notes does not identify the last build shipped in August 2020. A later reissue with the same version, a differently versioned build, or another publisher build cannot be distinguished from available evidence.

localArtifactSearch.method: PowerShell Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Force with case-insensitive filters for defraggler and dfsetup

migrationDisposition.legacySelection: Retain the user's selected Defraggler outcome as open scope; do not retire it based only on this source review.
migrationDisposition.blocker: Publisher has ended distribution and the exact last-build payload/source is unavailable; a supported acquisition path or user disposition is needed.

resolved: The official publisher's lifecycle announcement confirms discontinued Defraggler distribution and support.
partial: Official indexed release notes display version 2.22.995 from 2018, but the exact August 2020 last build and its payload identity remain unresolved.
deferred: Keep Defraggler implementation open until an authorized retained artifact/source or user disposition is available.

estimates.adjustment: None; version evidence improves, but no exact last-build artifact or closed legacy outcome results.
